evidence.quote: It is of utmost importance that we maintain credibility in pursuing our fight against inflation by proceeding carefully and deliberately to achieve our 2 percent goal.
But we cannot ignore the fact that monetary policy can present risks to the banking system and the broader financial system.
My remarks today focus on financial stability and the role of banking regulators in promoting financial stability and resiliency in the financial system.
In my view, it would be better to fix the roof now, while the sun is shining, by addressing over-calibrated leverage ratio requirements and moderating capital increases for the Basel III proposal.
